parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a switch button made of ABS plastic, typically rectangular and slightly protruding from the base body.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator for turning electrical circuits on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by pressing inward and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch button made of ABS plastic, similar in design to the first switch.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit, allowing independent operation of connected devices.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by pressing inward and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the wall switch, made of durable polycarbonate material.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support for the switches and houses the internal wiring and electrical contacts.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall surface.
